conditional_gate_headroom_seconds.method: For each of 247 green heads, latest other-gate completion minus this gate completion; these are observed finish slacks under common clocks, not potential savings.

single_gate_shift_sensitivity_from_paren.method: Move every Bazel completion earlier by a fixed amount, keep other gate clocks fixed, then recompute max-gate completion; this is conditional sensitivity, not measured/cause-attributed savings.

gate_job_intervals_on_247_green_heads.population: One selected latest successful job per required context per green head; job-created→started is runner queue; created→completed includes queue; started→completed is runner interval. Step intervals are from GitHub completed job steps.

retry_evidence.gap_definition: Prior required Bazel job completed after failure → next-attempt Bazel job created; distinct from runner queue and execution.
retry_evidence.feedback_sum_caveat: This sum is the full head-to-last-gate feedback duration of those heads, not the causal contribution of retries.

verified_changed_path_classes.measurement_boundary: Only current PRs whose exact head SHA matched the measured cohort SHA are classified. Pull-file lists are tied to matching immutable base/head SHAs observed before and after collection.
verified_changed_path_classes.class_rules: Exact changed filenames and available patches only; no PR title or branch-name inference. Primary categories are mutually exclusive; path tags overlap. The graph/dependency/config tag includes local BUILD and target metadata, not only global graph edits. The three test-only candidates have no database-related changed path or DB/SQL keyword in returned patches; this screen does not rule out a transitive fixture or runtime database dependency.

post_final_fixture_fix_soak.interpretation: All four green exact heads have CI logs naming the expected PR head and resolved synthetic merge source; GitHub commit-parent data matches the expected head and ancestry comparisons prove all four fixture merges are ancestors of each source commit base parent. Four green heads are too few and non-random; no causal savings estimate is supported. The window selects workflow creation time, so the last head starts at 12:44:43Z and completes after the 12:44:59Z collection boundary.

parent_independent_metrics.notes: Independent parent calculation; fixed offsets, one gate only, not measured savings; nearest-rank percentiles.
